- [2015] IRENA and Tesla signed a Memorandum of Understanding to collaborate on clean energy technologies, including energy storage, solar photovoltaics, and electric vehicles, resulting in off-grid projects in Africa.
- [2016] IRENA and ABB signed a Memorandum of Understanding to promote renewable energy integration into power grids, leading to projects like a microgrid in the Galapagos Islands and a smart grid in South Africa.
- [2017] IRENA and Enel Green Power signed a Memorandum of Understanding to promote renewable energy in developing countries, resulting in projects like a geothermal plant in Indonesia and a wind farm in Mexico.
- [2017] IRENA and Engie signed a Memorandum of Understanding to accelerate renewable energy deployment in developing countries, resulting in a 50 MW solar farm in Senegal and a 30 MW wind farm in Morocco.
- [2018] IRENA and Masdar signed a Memorandum of Understanding to promote renewable energy technologies in developing countries, resulting in a 50 MW solar power plant in Mali.
- [2019] IRENA and Vestas signed a Memorandum of Understanding to promote wind power in developing countries, resulting in a 50 MW wind farm in Kazakhstan.
- [2019] IRENA and Siemens signed a Memorandum of Understanding to promote renewable energy adoption in Africa, resulting in a 100 MW wind farm in Ethiopia and a 140 MW solar plant in Egypt.
- [2020] IRENA and Total signed a Memorandum of Understanding to promote renewable energy in Africa, focusing on solar energy and off-grid projects.
- [2020] IRENA and Marriott International signed a partnership to promote renewable energy in the hospitality industry, focusing on solar energy and energy efficiency.
- [2021] IRENA and EDP Renewables signed a Memorandum of Understanding to promote renewable energy in Latin America, focusing on wind and solar projects in Chile, Brazil, and Mexico.
